headline: Torvalds drops AI-disclosure rule and posts his first AI-assisted Linux kernel patch
summary: Linus Torvalds began using AI tools on Linux kernel work, posting his first AI-assisted patch, which included a synthetic test showing a 23x performance leap. Separately, kernel maintainers dropped the requirement that contributors disclose AI tool use, with Torvalds saying contributors must still understand their own code regardless of the tools they use.
